sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
• Wear the bracelet on your wrist as a daily accessory for style and positive intention.
• Before wearing, hold the bracelet for a few seconds and set your intention, such as wealth, confidence, success, focus, or abundance.
• Use the lobster clasp and jump rings to secure the bracelet comfortably around your wrist.
• You can wear it during work, business meetings, daily routines, travel, or special occasions.
• Avoid direct contact with water, perfume, sweat, and harsh chemicals to maintain its shine and quality for longer.
• After use, wipe gently with a soft dry cloth and store it safely in a pouch or jewellery box.
• For best results, wear it with a positive mindset, consistent effort, and focused action toward your goals.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Pyrite Crystal Rice Chain Bracelet – 24K Gold Plated

The Pyrite Crystal Rice Chain Bracelet is a handcrafted crystal energy bracelet designed for those who love accessories that feel bold, premium, and meaningful. Made with a structured non-stretchable rice chain design, this bracelet gives a secure wrist fit while adding a clean, aesthetic, and luxurious touch to your everyday styling.

This bracelet features 5 Pyrite crystals, known as money magnet crystals and often connected with wealth, success, confidence, abundance, and positive energy. The golden crystal detailing paired with the polished rice chain creates a rich and powerful look that feels stylish, modern, and easy to wear.

Crafted with a 24K gold finish, lobster clasp closure, and jump rings for easy opening, this bracelet is made for daily wear, gifting, smart looks, casual outfits, and statement styling. Brought to you by India’s biggest crystal energy brand, each crystal is authentic and certified, making this bracelet more than just an accessory — it is a meaningful piece of crystal energy jewellery.

• Pyrite Crystals: Known for wealth, success, confidence, abundance, and positive energy.

Disclaimer: Crystals support your intentions and energy, but real results come when you combine them with hard work, consistency, positive action, and mindful practice.
